title: Kids in the Tub
lines: The pup did dig in the mud.
Ten kids got a big tub.
The kids did tug the pup in the tub.
It got up. It did tip the tub!
The pup did go nap on the cot.
The kids sob. The pup is not sad.

questions.ask: Why did the kids get a tub?
questions.listenFor: To wash the muddy pup. Listen for the mud - the tub only makes sense because the pup was dirty.

questions.ask: How did the kids end up muddy?
questions.listenFor: The pup tipped the tub over. If your child says "it just happened," have them read that line again.

questions.ask: Do you think the pup will get in the tub next time? Tell me why you think so.
questions.listenFor: There is no wrong answer. You are listening for a reason from the story, like the pup got away with it, or the kids will hold on tighter.
